title: Oxford University Is Older Than the Aztecs
script: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire. Teaching was already happening at Oxford by 1096. The Aztecs didn't found their great city, Tenochtitlan, until 1325, more than two hundred years later. And the Aztec Empire itself only formed in 1428. So by the time the Aztecs were building pyramids in a lake, Oxford students had been sitting exams for centuries. History overlaps in ways that feel impossible.
